claims.text: The hotel is in the Central Business District of New Orleans, one block from the French Quarter and the Mississippi River, and within walking distance of the Arts/Warehouse District.

findings.quote: located at 300 Gravier Street in New Orleans’ Central Business District, one block from the French Quarter, the Mississippi River, and within walking distance of the Arts/Warehouse District

claims.text: Guests arrive through a private walled courtyard, a pocket of seclusion in the middle of downtown.

findings.quote: guests come in through a private walled courtyard, a rare pocket of seclusion and security in the middle of downtown

claims.text: The hotel opened in 1984.

findings.quote: In 1984 we opened our doors

claims.text: Most accommodations are true suites, with an entry foyer, living room and bedroom divided by real walls and doors.

findings.quote: Most of our accommodations are true suites rather than single hotel rooms, with a proper entry foyer, living room, and bedroom divided by real walls and doors

claims.text: Every room and suite has bedside tables with built-in charging stations and bathrooms in Italian marble.

findings.quote: Every room & suite has updated in-room amenities, bedside tables with built-in charging stations, and expansive bathrooms filled with rich Italian marble.

claims.text: The Club Level occupies floors 19 through 22, with a dedicated concierge and access to the Club Level Lounge, which serves breakfast, traditional afternoon tea, evening cocktails and hors d'oeuvres, and nightly desserts and cordials.

findings.quote: Club Level at The Windsor Court occupies floors 19 through 22 and includes a dedicated concierge and exclusive access to the Club Level Lounge
which serves a generous daily breakfast spread, traditional afternoon tea, evening cocktails and hors d’oeuvres, and nightly desserts and cordials

claims.text: Spa visits include a plush Italian robe, steam room, infrared sauna and relaxation lounges.

findings.quote: every visit includes a plush Italian robe, steam room and infrared sauna, relaxation lounges

claims.text: Personalized aromatherapy is included with every massage at the spa.

findings.quote: Personalized aromatherapy is included with every massage.

claims.text: Afternoon tea is served in Le Salon.

findings.quote: afternoon tea service in Le Salon

claims.text: The Polo Club serves classic cocktails with nightly live music.

findings.quote: classic cocktails with nightly live music in The Polo Club

claims.text: Pets are welcome, with a $150 per-stay hospitality charge instead of a traditional pet fee.

findings.quote: The Windsor Court warmly welcomes your four-legged companions
Instead of a traditional pet fee, we implement a Hospitality charge of $150 per stay.

claims.text: A complimentary house car is available for drop-offs within a 3-mile limit.

findings.quote: our complimentary house car is available for drop-off locations within 3-mile limit.

claims.text: The art collection includes paintings, sculptures, tapestries and furnishings by more than 60 artists from the 17th to the late 20th century; many works are British, with an emphasis on Windsor Castle and the life of British royalty, including originals by William Powell Frith, Sir Joshua Reynolds and Thomas Gainsborough.

findings.quote: The Windsor Court features a collection of paintings, sculptures, tapestries and furnishings by more than 60 artists dating from the 17th to late 20th centuries.
Many of the artworks are of British Origin with an emphasis on works that depict the Windsor Castle and life of British royalty.
The Collection includes original works by William Powell Frith, Sir Joshua Reynolds, Thomas Gainsborough and Jacob Huntsman.

claims.text: The rooftop saltwater pool has private cabanas, is heated for year-round use and is framed by views of the New Orleans skyline.

findings.quote: The Pool and Pool Bar offer a lush rooftop escape high above the city, framed by sweeping views of the New Orleans skyline.
featuring private cabanas, our recently renovated 65-foot saltwater pool is cool and refreshing in the summer, and heated for year-round enjoyment

claims.text: The James J. Coleman, Jr. Presidential Suite has private terraces, panoramic views across the Mississippi River and the French Quarter, a fireplace, an original Canaletto painting and a private gym.

findings.quote: Private rooftop terraces
panoramic views across the Mississippi River and the French Quarter
a fireplace, an original Canaletto painting, a Sonos sound system, a Miele espresso machine, and a private gym

claims.text: Many Deluxe and Premium Suites connect to adjoining guest rooms or neighboring suites to create multi-bedroom layouts.

findings.quote: Many Deluxe and Premium Suites connect to adjoining Guest Rooms or neighboring suites to create multi-bedroom layouts for larger groups.

claims.text: During the holidays the lobby has ten Colorado blue spruce trees and a centerpiece tree with more than 25,000 mini white lights and a toy train circling its base.

findings.quote: Ten Colorado blue spruce trees donning more than 3,000 ornaments and a myriad of wreaths and garland trimming adorn our lobby during the holiday season.
Our majestic centerpiece is a 19.5 foot tree boasting more than 25,000 mini white lights and a classic toy train circling the base.

claims.text: The hotel is in the Central Business District, one block from the French Quarter rather than inside it.

findings.quote: Central Business District, one block from the French Quarter
Set just beyond the energy of the French Quarter

claims.text: Spa treatments should be booked ahead, especially on weekends and during festival weeks such as Jazz Fest, Mardi Gras and the Sugar Bowl.

findings.quote: We strongly recommend reserving your treatment at The Windsor Court Spa ahead of time, especially for weekend visits, and festival weeks such as Jazz Fest, Mardi Gras, and the Sugar Bowl.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
